assistworld-assist-world:lever:4d9d36ec-.title: Personal & Executive Assistant
assistworld-assist-world:lever:4d9d36ec-.description: About the Role The client runs her own app development studio and is currently a lean team of one. She's looking for a Personal & Executive Assistant to take routine scheduling, communication, and life-admin tasks off her plate — with the flexibility to shift further toward personal support later this year if she transitions into a corporate role. The right candidate is comfortable moving between business and personal tasks and doesn't need heavy hand-holding to figure out logistics. Core Responsibilities Scheduling & Communication • Manage calendar and scheduling across business and personal commitments • Light inbox support and email management (low volume — no heavy customer-facing inbox) • Occasionally liaise with third parties on Amy's behalf (text/call/WhatsApp) when given access Travel & Events • Book and coordinate travel — flights, accommodation — for both business and personal trips • Handle restaurant bookings and event/appointment coordination Personal Support • Book doctor's appointments, gym sessions, and other personal errands • Handle groceries and other day-to-day logistics as needed • Remind about and help source gifts for important dates Ad Hoc / Research • Light research to help Amy stay on top of industry/market developments • Pull together options and information to support her decision-making Social Media (Light Touch) • Surface-level support only — scheduling/posting content, basic captions, occasional DM replies • Not a core specialist requirement — no dedicated social media management expected Not Required for This Role • Finance, bookkeeping, or invoicing • Vendor management or vendor research • Specialist/strategic social media management Ideal Candidate • 3–4+ years of experience as an EA/PA or similar • Comfortable supporting both business and personal tasks, and open to that balance shifting over time • Based in South Africa or the Philippines • Proficient with Google Workspace • Trustworthy, discreet, and comfortable with shared account access under an NDA • Self-sufficient — able to research and propose options rather than needing detailed instructions

burklandassociates-burklandassociates:as.description: ABOUT US Burkland's core purpose is to Accelerate Dreams. So often, turning dreams into reality helps change the world. We thrive at the forefront of this transformation. Startups desire our professionals as they are the best in the business. Startups seek our content because we are an industry thought leader. Startups trust our expertise, so founders can focus on their companies, products, and value-add. Because of our demonstrated value, our clients have raised more than $17.8B! At Burkland, we lead with our Core Purpose. We do this for both our clients and our employees. We believe that leaning on our Core Values (Fresh Perspectives, Exponential Value, Empathy, Trusted Partner) will lead to happy clients and happy employees. We are a remote-first company with over 185 team members, more than 800 clients, and a culture built on doing meaningful work with people who genuinely care about helping our clients grow. Come build something with us! THE ROLE We're looking for a CFO Advisory Consultant to serve as a long-term financial partner and advisor to clients operating under management services agreements between an MSO and its affiliated professional corporation(s) (PCs). As the de-facto senior finance team member for such clients, you'll own the numbers month over month, architect & manage the right systems, become a trusted voice to CEOs, physician leadership, and investors, and help clients navigate the capital requirements, entity mechanics, compliance boundaries, payment flows and unit economics that make the MSO/PC structure work. YOUR TYPICAL, ATYPICAL, DAY MAY INCLUDE: - Oversee monthly close, budgeting, and forecasting across the management company and affiliated PC(s), month after month. - Keep MSO/PC economics clean: intercompany billing, cost allocations, management fee settlements, and clear guardrails between the entities to ensure compliance. - Advise the CEO and physician leadership on financial strategy, including capital planning, growth, management fee strategy and execution. - Own the finance section of Board meetings, including MSO/PC KPI dashboards and investor updates. - Support fundraising and M&A e.g. sizing rounds, modeling scenarios, speaking investors' and acquirers' language. - Keep the fundamentals sharp: revenue cycle, cash flow planning, vendor spend, controls, growth potential and audit readiness. - Flag opportunities to bring in Burkland's bookkeeping, tax, and HR services. ABOUT YOU - Direct MSO/PC experience — management fee arrangements, intercompany settlements, practice-level unit economics. This is the top qualifier. - Other healthcare experience, particularly related to insurance reimbursements. - A history of managing and owning the numbers long-term, not just building fixed-fee FP&A models. - Experience advising through growth events — fundraising, M&A, and exits. Investment banking, venture capital, or corporate development background is a strong plus. - 7–10 years in finance/operations, ideally in healthcare growth sectors (digital health, telehealth, behavioral health/therapy services). - Excellent Excel/Sheets skills, plus strong familiarity with financial technology platforms such as QBO, Carta, Rippling, Ramp, Rillet, etc. - Experience with current AI tools, skills and LLMs as applied to the Office of the CFO - financial analysis, processes, accounting, reporting, etc. - MBA or CPA preferred, not required. - Strategic judgment and exceptional soft skills. - Candidates based in Austin, Boston, New York, or Northern California are preferred but not required. WHAT WE OFFER - 100% remote, work-from-anywhere flexibility. Forget the commute! We're a remote-first workplace, so you can set up your office at home, at a coworking space, or on the beach if you'd like — as long as you have a reliable internet connection. - Flexible work schedule to promote a healthy work-life balance. - A collaborative, communicative culture driven by our Core Purpose + Values. jobgether-jobgether:lever:563437e8-1cd3-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in France. This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows. You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations. The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness. You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates. The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core. You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices. Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios. Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles. Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks. Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities. Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios. Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis. Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria. Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines. Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards. Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness. Requirements Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems. Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows. Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns. Practical experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, RestAssured, or similar tools. Ability to diagnose technical issues using application logs, databases, API traces, and other debugging tools. Understanding of asynchronous systems and transaction patterns, including callbacks, queues, polling, retries, and failure handling. Previous experience in payments, fintech, or another environment involving highly reliable transactional systems is strongly valued. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated quality checks into software delivery processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks beyond individual feature requirements. SQL and data-validation skills are an advantage. Experience with distributed systems is a plus. Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI-powered tools for QA and test automation is beneficial. jobgether-jobgether:lever:df60f57d-b0f2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Design Engineer - MetaMask based in Spain. This is an opportunity for a senior frontend-focused engineer to shape intuitive, polished experiences used by millions of people interacting with Web3 products. You’ll work at the intersection of engineering, product, and design, turning complex user flows into fast, accessible, and delightful interfaces. The role combines hands-on development with a strong focus on interaction design, animation, micro-interactions, and visual craftsmanship. You’ll contribute across React and React Native while helping evolve scalable design systems and cross-platform frontend patterns. You’ll also explore AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows that accelerate design-to-code execution without compromising quality. Working with a globally distributed team, you’ll have significant autonomy while collaborating closely with designers, engineers, and product leaders. Your work will directly influence products and experiences used by a large, global community of Web3 users. Build pixel-perfect, production-ready interfaces using React and React Native, maintaining a high standard of visual and functional quality. Translate Figma designs into accessible, responsive experiences while minimizing friction between design and engineering. Create thoughtful animations, haptics, transitions, and micro-interactions that make digital experiences intuitive and engaging. Contribute to and expand a scalable design system with reusable, accessible components across platforms. Take concepts from early ideas and prototypes through implementation, testing, validation, and production release. Develop AI-assisted and agentic workflows that improve design-to-code processes and increase engineering efficiency while maintaining quality standards. Collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and engineers to solve complex interaction and frontend challenges. Advocate for high-quality product craft and identify opportunities to improve usability, performance, accessibility, and overall user experience. Balance attention to detail and product polish with practical delivery needs, making sound decisions about when to refine and when to ship. Requirements Proven experience as a senior frontend or design-focused engineer building and shipping high-traffic, consumer-facing products with React and React Native. Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript and TypeScript, with experience designing scalable cross-platform frontend architectures. Demonstrated expertise in frontend performance, accessibility, reusable UI patterns, and production-quality engineering. A strong portfolio showcasing polished interfaces, interaction design, animations, motion, and micro-interactions rather than static screens alone. Strong understanding of interaction and motion design, with the judgment to use animation and haptics purposefully rather than unnecessarily. Advanced Figma literacy and the ability to interpret design files and translate detailed designs into production-ready code. Experience contributing to or maintaining design systems and reusable component libraries. Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development, agentic workflows, LLM-based tooling, or similar approaches to accelerating software development. Experience with crypto wallets, blockchain, Web3 products, or related technologies is strongly preferred. Strong autonomy, initiative, and judgment, with the ability to work effectively across a globally distributed and asynchronous team. A collaborative mindset and strong communication skills, with the ability to work productively across engineering, design, and product disciplines. Ability to balance technical excellence and design quality with pragmatic delivery and business priorities. labhouse-labhouse:ashbyhq:8e17d45f-415c-.description: Labhouse is a Barcelona-based startup studio building AI-powered mobile apps used by hundreds of thousands of people worldwide. Our products — including Invoice Fly and Summary AI — are designed to make everyday tasks faster, smarter, and simpler through a subscription model that puts the user first. We were founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos, the duo behind SocialPoint (acquired by Take-Two Interactive), and we operate with the mindset of a product company: small teams, high ownership, and a relentless focus on building things that matter. Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below. THE ROLE At Labhouse, AI is not a feature — it's the core of what we build. As our AI Engineer, you will own the development, fine-tuning, and productionization of the models that make our apps work at a high level of accuracy and performance. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will: - Research, design, and train models suited to the specific needs of our products - Fine-tune existing open-source and foundation models to maximize accuracy and performance - Own the full model lifecycle: data curation, experimentation, evaluation, and production deployment - Collaborate with mobile and backend engineers to integrate models directly into our apps - Define and track the metrics that drive quality — and continuously push them in the right direction ABOUT YOU Academic Background A strong academic foundation matters to us. We're looking for candidates with a degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field. A Master's or PhD in machine learning or a related area is a strong plus — but not a requirement if you can demonstrate equivalent depth through your work. What We Are Looking For More than years of experience, we care about demonstrated ability to build. You should be able to point to models you've trained, fine-tuned, or shipped — whether in a professional setting, a research context, or on your own. A strong GitHub and/or Hugging Face profile is a significant advantage. - Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning deep learning models that are used in production. - Strong Python skills and experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch or JAX preferred) - Comfort with the full model development cycle: data pipelines, experiment tracking, evaluation, deployment and scaling. - Solid understanding of modern model architectures and when to apply them - Experience with the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, Datasets, Hub) is a strong plus - Ability to work autonomously, make decisions under uncertainty, and ship without waiting for perfect conditions AI Proficiency You actively use AI tools in your own workflow — not as a novelty, but as a genuine productivity multiplier. You stay current with the state of the art and know how to apply the latest research to real product problems. Communication You communicate clearly and directly. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders, flag blockers early, and collaborate effectively in a small, fast-moving team. Nice to Have - Experience across multiple model domains (vision, audio, NLP, multimodal) - Familiarity with on-device or edge inference optimization (quantization, distillation, ONNX) - Experience integrating ML models into mobile or production environments - Published research or open-source contributions in ML WHAT WE OFFER - Attractive compensation, above market average - Hybrid work model based in Barcelona - High ownership from day one — you define the direction, not just execute on it - Work directly with the founders and a senior, low-ego team - A real product with real users — your work will have immediate, measurable impact HIRING PROCESS 1.
